hypothesis: A wide supplied Boolean boundary can sometimes be represented by a compact exact message even when no single projector language covers the whole component, by discovering and joining several partial exact messages without enumerating 2^k assignments.

scope.forbidden_inference: Finite success on constructed mixed structured families is not a polynomial SAT theorem and does not prove P=NP.

holdout.construction_rule: Each component is a conjunction of two or three internally shifted structured submodules sharing the same supplied boundary. No whole-component projector may accept; only partial extraction from several languages may jointly recover the exact boundary relation.

frozen_gates.pass: all final messages and joins replay exactly against evaluation truth
>=0.90 of cases reject all whole-component single-language projectors
>=0.85 of cases require >=2 successful partial projector languages
median atoms/2^k <= 0.10 and max <= 0.35 for k>=8
for each frozen constructed family, median final message atoms at each k <= 6*k+24
no same-case promotion, protected challenger exposure nonzero, TruthGate sole authority
report adaptive vs static attempts; no scientific failure if no speedup
evaluation-only truth-table audit agrees with exact joined message on all cases where 2^k audit is within frozen cap

stop_rules: If any exact replay mismatch occurs, scientific verdict is REFUTED_EXACTNESS.
If resource caps are exceeded, use UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT rather than negative evidence.
Do not alter holdout families, k ladder, thresholds, candidate languages or governance after this preregistration is committed.
